Dear ⟦name|Marisol⟧,

On behalf of Quillfeather Analytics, Inc. (the "Company"), I am delighted to offer you the position of Staff Data
Engineer, Platform Ingestion (level IC5), reporting to ⟦name|Devraj "Dev" Kulkarni⟧, Director of Data Infrastructure.
This is a full-time, exempt position. You will work remotely from California and travel to our San Francisco office
about once per quarter.

1. Start Date. Your anticipated start date is Monday, November 16, 2026.

2. Compensation. Your annual base salary will be $212,000.00, paid semi-monthly and subject to standard withholdings.
You will also receive a one-time signing bonus of $25,000, repayable pro rata if you resign within 12 months.

3. Equity. Subject to Board approval, you will be granted 18,400 restricted stock units under the Company's 2021
Equity Incentive Plan, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff (25% on the first anniversary of the vesting
commencement date, then 6.25% quarterly).

4. Benefits. You will be eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage through our Blue Shield of California plan
(group no. 7720-QF), a 401(k) plan with a 4% match, 20 days of PTO plus 11 Company holidays, and a $1,500 annual
learning stipend. Coverage begins on your first day.

5. Conditions. This offer is contingent on (a) satisfactory completion of a background check conducted by a
third-party provider, and (b) verification of your identity and employment authorization on Form I-9 within three
business days of your start date. On Day 1 you will complete Section 1 of Form I-9 and enter your Social Security
number directly into Workday. Please do not email it, or copies of identity documents, to anyone at the Company.

6. Systems Access. Your employee ID will be ⟦employee id|QF-10482⟧ and your Okta username will be
⟦username|mechevarriaq⟧. A temporary password will be sent to your personal email address,
⟦email address|marisol.eq@protonmail.com⟧, 24 hours before your start date.

7. At-Will Employment. Your employment with the Company is "at will": either you or the Company may end it at any
time, with or without cause or notice. Nothing in this letter changes that.

8. Confidentiality. As a condition of employment you must sign the Company's Proprietary Information and Inventions
Assignment Agreement (PIIA), attached as Exhibit A.

This offer expires at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time on Friday, October 16, 2026. ⟦name|Dev⟧ and I are both happy to talk
through any questions. Call me directly at ⟦phone number|(628) 207-4419⟧, or reach ⟦name|Dev⟧ on his cell at
⟦phone number|773-864-2290⟧ (he is in Chicago, so Central Time).

We are very excited about the prospect of you joining us.

Sincerely,
